# PRIVACY POLICY

## PURPOSE OF THIS DOCUMENT

This Privacy Policy aims to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, how we treat it, to where it can be transferred and how you can update and delete your information. Our services, processes and communication systems aim to ensure the highest possible degree of compliance with the applicable law: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

## PERSON RESPONSIBLE FOR PERSONAL DATA

Name: Eva Kassotaki

Postal address: TU Delft | Innovation & Impact Centre, Building 26.C, van den Burghweg 1, 2628 CS Delft	

Contact email: E.Kassotaki@tudelft.nl

## DATA COLLECTION

Navigation on the project platform does not require any type of user registration. We collect information about you at the following moments when you use the FABRIX  platform(s):

* When you send a message through our contact form or direct email / if you contact us through the contact form or by sending an e-mail, the following data are collected: email address, name, subject of the contact and the message you are sending. We usually store the emails we receive for archive purposes and later contacts.;
* When you subscribe to the project newsletter through the project platform / in the case of newsletter subscription, we use the Mailchimp platform which saves your first name, last name, email address, IP Address and time of registration. This information is used only to send newsletters through the platform and to your email address;
* When you leave a comment and/or write an article on the project platform if this action is available (currently the Vetrine platform does not accept comments);
* When you visit and browse our website if you accept the cookies.

## LEGITIMACY IN THE TREATMENT OF YOUR DATA

Your data will only be saved if one of the following occurs:

You express your consent by sending an e-mail or submitting an online form;
The data is required to comply with a legal obligation to which the VETRINE project is subject, such as the disclosure of data to Tax Administration and Social Security authorities, as well to as other authorities.

## DATA RETENTION PERIOD

Your personal data will be kept for the minimum period of time necessary for the purposes described above and/or for compliance with legal obligations.The minimum time required is the duration of the project plus additional five year (for example: in a 3-year project your data will be kept for 8 years). After this period, your data will be removed from the database.

## HOW CAN WE SHARE YOUR INFORMATION

Your information will be shared only on request by the police or supervisory authorities when there is suspicion that an illegal act is being committed or if this disclosure would allow an illegal act to be prevented; or as required or authorized by law.

## YOUR RIGHTS

At any time, you can request:

* Access to your personal data;
* Alteration of your personal information;
* Direct editing of your personal information in cases where there is a registered user;
* Opposition to, cancellation or limitation in the treatment of your personal data;
* Portability of your personal data previously provided, in a structured and compatible manner and in a readable format;
* For your data to be deleted and forgotten.
* To exercise your rights, please contact us through the following e-mail E.Kassotaki@tudelft.nl. Your requests will be treated with care, so that we can ensure the effectiveness of your rights. You will be asked to prove your identity, so to ensure that personal data are shared only with the owner. Please note that, in certain cases and in accordance with applicable law, your request may not be satisfied immediately or in full. In all cases, you will be informed of the measures taken, within 30 days from the time the request is made.

## CLARIFICATIONS OR DOUBTS
If you have any questions regarding this policy or other privacy issues, or if you wish to exercise any of your rights, please contact us at E.Kassotaki@tudelft.nl.

## COOKIES POLICY

The cookies and similar technologies used across the FABRIX websites are described in our [Cookies Policy](/privacy-policy/cookies).

# COOKIES POLICY

*Last updated: 28 August 2026*

## SCOPE

This policy explains the cookies and similar technologies used on the websites operated by the FABRIX project:

* **fabrixproject.eu** — the project website;
* **platform.fabrixproject.eu** — the FABRIX platform;
* **learn.fabrixproject.eu** — the FABRIX Learning Hub.

It complements our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy), which explains how we handle personal data generally.

## WHAT A COOKIE IS

A cookie is a small text file that a website asks your browser to store on your device. It allows the site to recognise your browser on a later page or visit. Similar technologies, such as your browser's local storage, serve comparable purposes and are covered by this policy where we use them.

## WHAT WE USE, AND WHAT IT STORES

### Audience measurement

The project website and the platform use **Matomo**, an open-source analytics tool that we host ourselves at *stats.daysplit.com*. It tells us how many people visit and which pages they read, so that we can improve the content produced by the project.

Matomo runs in **cookieless mode**: it sets no cookies and stores nothing on your device. It records the page you visited, the site that referred you and basic information about your browser, and uses them only to produce aggregate audience figures.

Matomo is self-hosted: the data stays on infrastructure operated for the project. It is not shared with advertising networks, it is not used for profiling or advertising, and it is not sold.

Because nothing is stored on your device for audience measurement, there is no cookie banner to accept or refuse.

### Strictly necessary storage on the platform

Signing in to **platform.fabrixproject.eu** stores a small number of values in your browser's local storage: the tokens that keep you signed in, and which organisation you last had open. These are not cookies and are not sent to any third party, but they are stored on your device. They are required for the platform to work; clearing them signs you out.

### The Learning Hub sets nothing

**learn.fabrixproject.eu** sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser. It loads no third-party scripts, fonts or trackers. Video recordings are embedded from YouTube only after you click play — until then, no request is made to YouTube and no cookie is set by it.

## HOW TO CONTROL WHAT IS STORED

The only data any FABRIX site keeps on your device is the platform sign-in information described above.

You can accept, refuse or delete cookies and site data at any time through your browser settings. Every major browser lets you block storage for a specific site, delete what is already stored, or refuse it entirely. Doing so has no effect on the project website or the Learning Hub, which store nothing. On the platform it will sign you out, because that stored session is what keeps you signed in.

## CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We update this policy when the tools we use change. The date at the top shows when it was last revised.

## CONTACT

For any question about this policy or about how we handle your data, contact us at E.Kassotaki@tudelft.nl.
